description: [Simulated] Imbalance prices per quarter-hour (Live updates as of 24/11/2026 10h conditional on CREG approval) is a dataset listed in Elia open data platform, an open data platform of a transmission system operator, published or maintained by Elia Group. Imbalance prices and components used in it's calculation, used for balance responsible parties (BRPs) settlement for every quarter hour. This dataset will start receiving live updates every quarter hour as from 24/11/2026 10h on. Coverage: Belgium. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Balancing. Its keywords are Market, Imbalance prices, Near real-time. The portal shows 2025-06-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Elia Open Data Licence (/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-elia-open-data-portal.
